text: The cyanide process. The concentrated ore is stirred with dilute sodium cyanide while air is blown through. Silver sulphide dissolves as the soluble complex sodium dicyanoargentate. But the reaction is reversible, and would stop early. The air oxidises the sodium sulphide product as it forms, so the equilibrium is pulled to the right. Le Chatelier's principle doing real industrial work.
